The '''Iridium Scythe''' is a tool that is obtained after claiming [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Farming Mastery]].

The Iridium Scythe has the following benefits:
* Can harvest items grown on tilled soil within its swing range, including regular [[crops]], those grown in [[Garden Pot]]s, [[Spring Onion]]s, and other forageables grown from [[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds]].
* Its radius is larger than the [[Golden Scythe]]<ref name="weaponsData" /> and it is more likely to cut all grass in its radius.
* 100% chance per swipe to harvest hay from grass, up from 75%.<ref name="hayChance"/>
* Inflicts 20 damage, up from 13.<ref name="weaponsData"/>

It is the most powerful version of the Scythe. It increases the effectiveness of the [[Scythe]] and [[Golden Scythe]] by a substantial amount and adds a purple hue.
